title: Joining the band in Pittsburgh
summary: He recalls the William Penn Hotel as his first job with Basie and cannot recall how he got there.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: No. It was new and different. Definitely. Okay, so you didn't see really very much more of Billy at that point then, maybe?
No, but he's in the band.
I know -- but I just want to get the timing on this exactly. So, when you hear from Basie again --
Mm hmm.
-- you're going back that same night to work? In the Village?
Yeah. Working that same night.
So, when do you hear from Basie?
Well, I don't remember exactly when, or how it was told to me that --. The next thing that I heard was that -- 'be at --' I know the next job was the William Penn Hotel.
In Pittsburgh?
In Pittsburgh.
Oh, really?
Yeah. We jump right from there to the William Penn Hotel.
And, you were just told the bus leaves at something or other?
Yeah. Wait a minute now. I'll have to think about that. I don't remember whether -- whether they were already there --
-- And they sent for you?

And Bobby Moore and I went to -- wait a minute, wait a minute, now. I'm trying to remember whether Bobby and I went to Pittsburgh together and joined the band, or whether he joined the band later on. It seems to me like maybe I went to Pittsburgh alone. Can't remember whether I caught a train, or a bus, or how I got there. I really don't remember that.
No. Well, somebody must have paid your ticket?
Oh, yeah, but --
You know, somebody must have contacted you? You don't think it was John, then?
It could have been.
John must have stayed in touch with you.
Yeah. It could have been John, you know. It could have been John, but I really don't remember right now. Maybe it will come to me.
Yeah.
